name: Frank Maddox
notes: Known from one post to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (23 June 2002), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/ot-roleplay-critique-2002-06-23.html: Frank Maddox, an ex-cop (the narration calls him a murderer who hid behind his former badge) wrestling in the SWP's tournament, argues with his agent Tony on the road to Chicago and learns he faces Triple J next and then Haaglund or 'Hardcore' Harlacker.
caption: A Chicago narcotics officer who killed an unarmed man and turned to the SWP's ring in June 2002, managed by the mobster agent Tony Suriconi.

name: Tony Suriconi
notes: Known from one post to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (23 June 2002), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/ot-roleplay-critique-2002-06-23.html: Tony Suriconi, Frank Maddox's agent and 'a con-artist mobster', drives him from Madison toward Chicago, books a motel room and leaves Frank in the car, then relays the SWP's call about the tournament and a raise.
caption: Frank Maddox's mob-connected agent in the SWP, June 2002, who takes sixty-five percent and hustles the front gate.
